offers.name: The Habit Refund
offers.tagline: Show up 36 times in 90 days and we pay you back.
offers.Commercial job: Raise first-purchase value and build the early habit
offers.Mechanics: Pay 3M at list within 72 hours of the trial (instead of the standing 15% now). Attend 36 classes in the first 90 days → 20% of the price back as studio credit, valid 60 days for the next purchase.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹4.5L counted (+₹90.7k vs the ₹3.6L stream plan) · 14 buyers
offers.Why it works: Clients choose between 15% now or 20% later if they show up. Committed buyers pick the refund, and the credit can only be spent on a second purchase, which is where loyalty forms (first purchases renew at 40–45%, repeat renewals at 64–68%). Usage is the strongest renewal predictor in the data (fully used 62% vs under-half 22%).
offers.What to watch: Earn rate (plan for ~40% earning, so the real cost is ~8%). Credit redemption within 60 days.
offers.Model: 59 in pool × 23.7% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 14.0 buyers × ₹31.9k ticket (40% take the featured product) = ₹4.5L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Habit Insurance
offers.tagline: Commit for 3 months. Life happens; your membership waits.
offers.Commercial job: Remove the "what if I travel or get sick" objection to 3M
offers.Mechanics: 3M at the standing 15% + stacked: 2 extra freeze attempts, a 15-minute goal-setting consult with a trainer, 2 guest passes for friends. Stacked: 2 extra freezes, 15-min trainer consult, 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: Same cash cost as the standing perk, but the stack makes the 3M feel safe. 3M renews at 68–74% vs 53–59% for 1M, so moving first buyers up the ladder is worth more than the discount.
offers.What to watch: Share of January new buyers on 3M+ (target ≥45%).

offers.name: 21 in 21 Kickstart
offers.tagline: 21 days unlimited. Hit 15 classes and the fee comes off your 3M.
offers.Commercial job: Low-risk entry that filters for habit, then upgrades
offers.Mechanics: 21-day unlimited intro (Mumbai ₹10,500, Bengaluru ₹8,399 — Kenkere already sells "The 21-Day Trial"). Attend 15+ classes → the full fee is credited against a 3M bought within 7 days of the end (≈18–20% on the 3M).
offers.Why it works: Kenkere's problem is conversion: 3.4% lead→commitment, website leads reach a trial 7.5% of the time. A cheap, time-boxed entry gets more people to commit to something, and the 15-class gate selects the clients who will renew. Revenue shown is the kickstart fee only; the 3M follow-on is upside.
offers.What to watch: Kickstart → 3M conversion (target 35%). Cap the 3M credit so effective discount on the 3M stays ≤20%.

offers.name: Unfinished Business
offers.tagline: You left 2 classes behind. We kept them.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed clients who let credits expire get up to 2 of them reinstated when they buy a 12-class pack or bigger. Replaces the standing 15% (not stacked).
offers.Expected revenue: ₹4.6L counted (+₹1.1L vs the ₹3.6L stream plan) · 46 buyers
offers.Why it works: Endowment effect: people value "their" lost classes more than an equal discount. It also reaches the under-used clients (packs used under 50% renew at 22–24%) with a reason to return.
offers.What to watch: Only clients with expired unused credits. Bengaluru effective ≈21.6%.
offers.Model: 523 in pool × 8.0% plan rate × 1.10 conversion factor = 46.2 buyers × ₹10k ticket (27% take the featured product) = ₹4.6L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: An Old Friend
offers.tagline: A comeback class, a plan, and the 15% you already have.
offers.Commercial job: Baseline lapsed sequence with a human touch
offers.Mechanics: Standing 15% on an 8-class pack or bigger + free comeback class + 15-minute "reset" consult with a trainer and a 2-week attendance plan. Clients with ≥₹50k lifetime spend get a manager call. Stacked: comeback class, 15-min reset consult, 2-week attendance plan.
offers.Why it works: Keeps the cash cost at the standing perk and adds structure. Reactivations earn ₹4.8–8.3k each, so personal calls go only to the high-value group.
offers.What to watch: Reactivation rate of the 61–365-day pool (Bandra 2.8% → 3.4% a month).

offers.name: The Second Chance
offers.tagline: 36 days for the price of 30.
offers.Commercial job: Catch December lapsers before the habit is gone
offers.Mechanics: Clients lapsed 0–90 days after Nov–Dec: 1M at list + 6 extra days. Valid 2–20 Jan.
offers.Why it works: Recent lapsers return fastest; time is cheaper than cash at 42–45% fill. Effective 20%, the cap for ≤1M products.
offers.What to watch: Restrict to 0–90 days lapsed so it doesn't pull forward active renewals.

offers.name: The Re-Up Ladder
offers.tagline: The longer you commit, the bigger the thank-you.
offers.Commercial job: Renew at list and push the ticket up
offers.Mechanics: Renew at list: 1M +1 class, 3M +7 days, 6M +14 days, Annual +30 days and a Members' Circle invite. No % off.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹22.2L counted (+₹2.0L vs the ₹20.1L stream plan) · 81 buyers
offers.Why it works: Full-price renewers renew again at 61–68% vs 50–54% after discounts. The ladder rewards upgrades (20–26% of renewals already upgrade) without training clients to wait for codes.
offers.What to watch: Renewal ticket vs plan (KH ₹24.0k, SHQ ₹21.7k, KK ₹14.3k).
offers.Model: 120 in pool × 65.8% plan rate × 1.02 conversion factor = 80.6 buyers × ₹27.5k ticket = ₹22.2L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Usage Prescription
offers.tagline: We looked at your last 3 months. Here's the plan that fits.
offers.Commercial job: Rebuild the renewal ticket with data
offers.Mechanics: T-14 call with a usage-based recommendation: 8+ visits a month on 1M → 3M at list + 7 days; under 50% used → a smaller pack + attendance plan. 2 guest passes for renewing on the prescribed product within 7 days. Stacked: 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: Bandra's ticket fell ₹24.3k → ₹21.2k from mix drift, not refusals. Usage-based advice moves 8+-visit members up and keeps light users from lapsing.

offers.name: Go Long in January
offers.tagline: 6 months or a year, plus a month on us.
offers.Mechanics: 6M or Annual renewal at list + 30 extra days. Annual renewers also get the standing annual perks.
offers.Why it works: Jan-2026 sold 8 annuals (₹12.5L) that come due now. Long commitments retain best (6M 63–77%, annual 71%).
offers.What to watch: Effective 16.7% on 6M, 8.2% on Annual — within the 3M+ cap only for annual; keep 6M to +21 days if strict.

hook: Renewal book + full-price trial conversion
job: Re-up the expiring annual book at full value, convert trial demand at full price, and reactivate the lapsed — without setting a discount anchor for the year.
moment: The month is built from three revenue streams. Renewals carry it: an annual book comes due and is re-signed in a ladder of longer terms. New clients convert from trial at list, with a refund-of-habit mechanism instead of a price cut. Winback works the lapsed list with a single, honest comeback offer.

offers.name: The Duo Rate
offers.tagline: Trial together, start together, train together.
offers.Commercial job: Two genuinely new clients per sale
offers.Mechanics: Two first-timers who trial together and both buy a 12-class pack+ within 72 hours: standing 15% each + one shared 30-minute duo private.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹3.5L counted (+₹37.4k vs the ₹3.2L stream plan) · 20 buyers
offers.Why it works: Replaces BOGO, which went mostly to existing clients (6–21% new) and renewed at 33–53%. Only two new clients unlock it, and referrals convert at 25% at Kwality.
offers.What to watch: Both buyers must be new. Effective ≈21.7% Mumbai, 22.9% Bengaluru.
offers.Model: 78 in pool × 21.8% plan rate × 1.15 conversion factor = 19.5 buyers × ₹18.1k ticket (55% take the featured product) = ₹3.5L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Love Language Menu
offers.tagline: Pick the perk that says it best.
offers.Mechanics: New 3M+ buyers: standing 15% + choose one: Quality Time (30-min private), Gifts (retail item), Acts of Service (2 extra freezes + priority booking), Words (written 12-week plan from a trainer).
offers.Why it works: Choice increases perceived value at no extra cost; every option is worth less than a 30-minute private. Only 3M+ qualifies, which pulls the first ticket toward ₹42–49k.
offers.What to watch: Track which perk is chosen; it tells you what new clients value.

offers.name: Plus-One, Minus Excuses
offers.tagline: Bring a friend. When they join, you both win.
offers.Mechanics: Friend: newcomer intro + standing 15%. Referrer: 2 bonus classes when the friend buys a commitment product.
offers.Why it works: Referral is the cheapest channel with 25% conversion at Kwality. The referrer bonus is acquisition cost, not a discount to the buyer.

offers.name: We Need to Talk
offers.tagline: It's not you. It was our schedule. Let's try again.
offers.Mechanics: Break-up letter themed message. Standing 15% on 1M + comeback class + 2 extra freezes so they can't "break up" again over travel.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹2.6L counted (+₹40.2k vs the ₹2.2L stream plan) · 36 buyers
offers.Why it works: the pair gives a story without a deeper discount. Freezes answer the most common lapse reason without cash.
offers.Model: 456 in pool × 7.9% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 36.0 buyers × ₹7.3k ticket (20% take the featured product) = ₹2.6L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Come Back as a Pair
offers.tagline: Return with a friend. Their first class is on us.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed client returns at standing 15% on a 12-class pack; brings a friend for a free intro. If the friend buys, the lapsed client gets 2 guest passes and 48-hour priority booking. Stacked: friend intro, 2 guest passes, priority booking.
offers.Why it works: Two streams from one message: reactivation and a warm new lead. Rewards are seats and access, so the cash cost stays at 15%.
offers.What to watch: Friends who buy (counts as new-client revenue).

offers.name: The Reunion Class
offers.tagline: One Saturday, all your old class friends.
offers.Commercial job: Turn a hosted class into reactivations
offers.Mechanics: Hosted reunion class Sat 13 Feb for lapsed clients. Encore QR at the door: 12-class pack at 12% + 1 bonus class within 7 days.
offers.Why it works: Hosted visits convert at 1–3% without a door offer; the Encore mechanic with a named associate is what lifts them.
offers.What to watch: Conversion at the door (target 10% of attendees).

offers.name: The Couple's Plan
offers.tagline: Renew with your workout partner.
offers.Mechanics: Two members renewing 3M+ together: 5% off each + one shared 30-minute duo private.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹20.9L counted (+₹5.0L vs the ₹15.8L stream plan) · 87 buyers
offers.Why it works: Pairs keep each other attending, and attendance predicts renewal. A hypothesis to test: tag pair renewals and compare their next renewal rate.
offers.What to watch: Next-renewal rate of pairs vs singles (data gap until tagged).
offers.Model: 83 in pool × 102.4% plan rate × 1.02 conversion factor = 86.7 buyers × ₹24.1k ticket (30% take the featured product) = ₹20.9L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Better Together Renewals
offers.tagline: Renew and bring someone in.
offers.Mechanics: Renew at list; if a friend you refer buys in February, +7 days (unlimited) or +1 class (packs).
offers.Why it works: Renewal moments are when clients are happiest; ask for the referral then.

offers.name: Usage Prescription
offers.tagline: Your renewal, sized to how you actually train.
offers.Mechanics: T-14 usage-based recommendation: 8+ visits on 1M → 3M at list + 7 days; under 50% used → smaller pack + plan.
offers.Why it works: Same evidence as January: mix drift lowered the ticket; usage advice reverses it.

hook: Referral-led new client growth
job: Grow new clients through the second seat rather than a discount: the companion membership is the offer, and the first membership is never cut.
moment: New clients are the growth stream this month, and they arrive in pairs. A duo rate prices the second seat, a referral credit pays out in classes rather than cash, and winback returns to the members who left as a pair — so acquisition is bought with product, not with margin.

offers.name: She Moves: Pay It Forward

offers.Commercial job: Purpose-led acquisition with a built-in referral
offers.Mechanics: homecoming week week: new 3M+ buyers get the standing 15% + 2 guest passes, and we gift a free class to a woman they nominate (mother, colleague, friend). Gifted classes enter the Encore flow.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹4.5L counted (+₹83.6k vs the ₹3.7L stream plan) · 16 buyers
offers.Why it works: Gives the purchase a story to share. The gifted class is acquisition cost and creates a warm lead.
offers.Model: 74 in pool × 21.6% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 16.0 buyers × ₹28.3k ticket (40% take the featured product) = ₹4.5L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Strong Women Squad

offers.name: The Pre-Game

offers.Commercial job: Stop March trials waiting for the anniversary
offers.Mechanics: March trials: buy within 72 hours at standing 15% → early access to April's anniversary box + 1 bonus class on 3M. Stacked: early access to April box.
offers.Why it works: March is a trough (Kwality ₹19–20L). Giving March buyers April status removes the reason to delay.

offers.name: Re-Run Your Best Month
offers.tagline: Remember March 2025? 18 classes. Let's beat it.
offers.Mechanics: Message shows the client's best month. 1M at list; match that class count → +6 days.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹4.3L counted (+₹84.1k vs the ₹3.5L stream plan) · 47 buyers
offers.Why it works: Personal data beats generic offers and sets a goal. The reward is earned, so cost only lands on clients who attend.
offers.What to watch: Needs a per-client best-month field from Momence.
offers.Model: 561 in pool × 8.0% plan rate × 1.05 conversion factor = 47.3 buyers × ₹9.1k ticket (23% take the featured product) = ₹4.3L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Class of 2024 Reunion
offers.tagline: Where it all started. One class, the whole launch crew.
offers.Mechanics: Hosted reunion for clients lapsed 1–2 years (and 61–365). Rebuy within 7 days: 12-class pack at 12% + 1 bonus class.
offers.Why it works: May–Sep 2024 brought 1,000+ first visits at Bandra; 638 are now lapsed 1–2 years. Reaching people who already know the studio is the cheapest reach Bandra has.
offers.What to watch: Reunion RSVPs → attendance → purchase. Repeat in September.

offers.name: The Homecoming
offers.tagline: Come back, and bring her with you.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed clients returning 8–14 Mar: standing 15% on an 8-class pack + a free class to gift a friend. Stacked: gift class for a friend.
offers.Why it works: Simple, on-theme, cash cost unchanged.

offers.name: Lock In Early
offers.tagline: Renew in March, keep April's perks.
offers.Commercial job: Protect Q1 renewals without pull-forward discounts
offers.Mechanics: Members expiring 1 Mar–15 Apr renew at list + 2 bonus classes (packs) or +7 days (unlimited) + first pick of anniversary hosted classes.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹14.7L counted (+₹56.4k vs the ₹14.1L stream plan) · 63 buyers
offers.Why it works: In 2026 ₹36.7L of Kwality's April came from early renewals at 30%+. Giving March renewers bonus time protects the ticket.
offers.Model: 100 in pool × 61.0% plan rate × 1.04 conversion factor = 63.4 buyers × ₹23.1k ticket = ₹14.7L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Pre-Game Upgrade
offers.tagline: Moving up? Your anniversary box ships early.
offers.Mechanics: 1M renewers with 8+ visits a month → 3M at list + anniversary retail item + 2 guest passes. Stacked: 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: 3M renews at 71% at Kenkere vs 59% for 1M. A retail item costs far less than a % code.

offers.name: Spring Reset Check-in
offers.tagline: Renew with a plan, not a discount.
offers.Mechanics: Every March renewal comes with a 15-minute trainer assessment and a programme. Renew now, start up to 14 days later. Stacked: trainer assessment, flexible start date.
offers.Why it works: Zero-discount baseline for studios that don't need a renewal push in March.

hook: Winback of the launch-year book
job: Rebuild the reactivation stream: bring the lapsed launch cohort home on a reunion offer, and close March trials inside the month instead of letting them slide into April.
moment: Reactivation is the month’s growth stream. A reunion-led winback works the oldest cohort on the book, a trial offer closes in-week so demand does not defer, and a renewal ladder protects the first-quarter book while acquisition runs warm rather than loud.

offers.name: Build Your Box
offers.tagline: The bigger your commitment, the bigger the anniversary box.
offers.Commercial job: Higher-value first purchases at a protected price
offers.Mechanics: Standing 15% on everything + a box that grows: 12-pack → shaker bottle; 3M → bottle + 2 guest passes + 15-min consult; 6M → full box + 1 private.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹6.0L counted (+₹81.7k vs the ₹5.2L stream plan) · 18 buyers
offers.Why it works: April lifts every studio 1.35–2.3× as a moment; depth didn't drive it (Bandra doubled its discount and earned less). Value scales with commitment, so the box pulls buyers up without a deeper %.
offers.What to watch: Effective 18.5% (Mumbai) / 19.7% (Bengaluru) on 3M; above the 15% 3M+ guardrail — drop the retail item on 3M if strict.
offers.Model: 88 in pool × 20.5% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 18.0 buyers × ₹33.5k ticket (45% take the featured product) = ₹6.0L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Commitment Issues Pack
offers.tagline: 3 months, 15% off, and two friends on us.
offers.Mechanics: 3M at 15% + 2 guest passes for friends (friends enter the Encore flow). Stacked: 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: The approved 2027 playbook offer: first ticket ≈₹49.2k (Mumbai) / ₹35.9k (Kenkere) at exactly the 15% cap.

offers.name: The 57-Hour Shake-Up
offers.tagline: Trialled in April? You have 57 hours.
offers.Mechanics: Trials in April get a 57-hour window: 12-class pack at standing 15% + a sealed mystery envelope (guaranteed perk: freeze, guest pass, retail item or 30-min private; average value ₹1,000).
offers.Why it works: Median trial-to-purchase is 3 days and 75% convert within 9 days. A short, named window plus a surprise drives the decision. The envelope stays a hidden extra, not the headline, so the brand stays premium.
offers.What to watch: Envelope mix must keep average value ≤₹1,000 (Bengaluru effective ≈22.6%).

offers.name: Since Day One
offers.tagline: You first shook with us on 12 Jun 2023. One class for every year.
offers.Mechanics: Message shows the client's first-class date. 12-class pack at list + 1 bonus class per year with us (max 2).
offers.Expected revenue: ₹8.7L counted (+₹1.4L vs the ₹7.3L stream plan) · 80 buyers
offers.Why it works: Anniversary month, personal anniversary. Loyalty is rewarded in classes, not price.
offers.What to watch: Needs first-visit date per client (available in Day End – New).
offers.Model: 951 in pool × 8.0% plan rate × 1.05 conversion factor = 79.8 buyers × ₹10.9k ticket (25% take the featured product) = ₹8.7L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Text Your Ex-ercise
offers.tagline: Years later, still shaking. You coming?
offers.Commercial job: Reactivate the lapsed in the biggest month
offers.Mechanics: Standing 15% on a 12-class pack + comeback class; rebuy within 7 days → mystery envelope.
offers.Why it works: April has the most attention of the year; lapsed clients see the campaign anyway. The 7-day rule keeps the decision fast.
offers.What to watch: Bandra needs 54 reactivations in April from 673 touches.

offers.name: Still Shaking Reunion Week
offers.tagline: An anniversary class just for returning faces.
offers.Commercial job: Hosted reactivation with a door offer
offers.Mechanics: Anniversary hosted class reserved for lapsed clients. Encore at the door: 1M at 15% + 2 guest passes. Stacked: 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: Turns the anniversary into a homecoming. A named associate at the door is mandatory (hosted visits convert at 1.4–2.9% without one).

offers.name: The Founding 57 · Coronation
offers.tagline: Fifty-seven numbered annual memberships, crowned in a gala: tiers, a founding wall, and a seat that is never sold again.
offers.Commercial job: Sell the flagship of the year: numbered annuals, capped by seat count, closed on the anniversary.
offers.Mechanics: Fifty-seven numbered annual memberships in three tiers — Regent (12 seats), Sovereign (30), Founding Circle (15). Each is a full-value 12-month unlimited, crowned at the anniversary gala, names engraved on the founding wall, and closed on the night of the anniversary. Tier perks are experience, not cash: private studio hours, a class of your own, first call on every launch through the year.
offers.Why it works: A numbered annual sells belonging, not a price. Three tiers let the room choose its commitment instead of negotiating a discount, the cap makes the deadline real, and the ceremony gives every buyer a moment worth telling someone about — which is the referral engine the following month runs on.
offers.What to watch: The cap must stay hard. The moment a seat is re-opened after the close, the number on the wall stops meaning anything and the tier price follows it down.
offers.Model: 135 numbered annuals at an average 33,800; no cash discount beyond the standing pack perks.
offers.Stacked perks: Coronation ceremony with a numbered seat; engraved founding wall; private studio hour per tier; first call on 2028 launches; a birthday class for the member’s own day.

offers.name: Lock In Before You Clock Out
offers.tagline: Renew in April at today's price with bonus classes.
offers.Commercial job: Protect Apr–Jun renewals without deep pull-forward
offers.Mechanics: Members expiring 1 Apr–15 Jun only: renew at list + 3 bonus classes (packs), +7 days (1M), +14 days (3M+). No % off.
offers.Why it works: 2026 anniversary-code buyers renewed at 24.5% at Kwality; full-price renewers at 61.6%. Restricting to near-term expiries limits pull-forward.
offers.What to watch: Renewal purchases vs due (plan KH 130 vs 120 due).

offers.name: The Long Game
offers.tagline: Go longer, get more time.
offers.Mechanics: Annual +30 days; 6M +14 days; 3M +6 classes. For members with 8+ visits a month and 1M/pack renewers.
offers.Why it works: Approved 2027 playbook offer: 8–14% effective, rewards length.

hook: The anniversary: numbered annuals, capped and closed
job: Sell the year’s flagship — numbered annual memberships, capped by seat count and hard-closed on a date — inside an anniversary programme that fills the room for a month.
moment: The anniversary is the product, and the flagship is a numbered annual: scarce, tiered, and sold as belonging rather than as a price. Around it runs the birthday programme — a coronation gala, themed classes across all formats, a founding-members wall, and daily celebration moments — so the renewal stream is sold by the room, not by a discount.

actions.text: Coronation build: number the 57 seats, brief the team on the three tiers, and open the waitlist to the founding book.
Anniversary identity live: birthday campaign across WhatsApp, email and Instagram, with the seat counter on every asset.
Founding book calls: every member from the launch year is called personally and offered their original number where it is still free.
The Coronation Gala: one evening, all 57 seats on the wall, tier reveals, cake, and the first names engraved.
Birthday class week: every format runs a themed anniversary class — throwback playlists, founding-year choreography, guest instructors.
Founding wall reveal: photographs of every member from the launch year, printed and hung, with a card and a personal invitation to the gala.
Regent tier push: the 12 highest-value seats are worked one to one, with private studio hours as the closer.
Comeback party: one evening class for everyone who lapsed in the launch year, free, no pitch in the room.
Birthday treats all week: cake at the desk, a photographer in the studio, member birthday cards, and the anniversary playlist.
Final seats: publish the remaining count every morning, and close every open conversation before the ceremony.
The Closing Night: last seats crowned, wall completed, and the 2028 waitlist opened to the room before it leaves.
Afterparty handover: every coronation member gets a thirty-day plan, so May starts on a habit instead of a receipt.
