offers.name: Summer Comeback Squad
offers.tagline: Rejoin with a group that starts the same day.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed clients join a 4-week comeback squad: 1M at standing 15% + fixed slot, trainer WhatsApp group, week-4 consult. Stacked: squad slot, week-4 consult.
offers.Why it works: Lapsed clients often need a reason and a routine more than a price. Reactivations renew at only 37–47%, so the squad builds the habit first.
offers.What to watch: Squad members renewing at the end of 1M.

offers.name: Late Entry
offers.tagline: Missed the anniversary? Here's your 7-day late entry.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed clients who opened April messages but didn't buy: 7 days, standing 15% on a 12-class pack + mystery envelope.
offers.Why it works: Retargets warm intent from April without extending April itself (an extension trains clients to wait).
offers.What to watch: Run only for clients who engaged with April messages.

offers.name: The Afterparty
offers.tagline: Book 8 in May, get a hosted class and a progress check.
offers.Mechanics: All April buyers and May renewers: book 8 classes in May → free hosted class + trainer progress check. Renew at list.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹15.5L counted (+₹59.7k vs the ₹14.9L stream plan) · 68 buyers
offers.Why it works: Success measure: ≥55% of April commitment buyers renew at next expiry (2026 anniversary-code buyers: 24.5% at Kwality, 51% at Bandra).
offers.Model: 108 in pool × 60.2% plan rate × 1.04 conversion factor = 67.6 buyers × ₹23k ticket = ₹15.5L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Streak Saver
offers.tagline: 3 classes a week for 4 weeks = bonus time.
offers.Mechanics: May renewers who keep 3 classes a week for 4 weeks: +5 days (unlimited) or +1 class (packs).
offers.Why it works: Pays only for attendance, which raises the next renewal.

offers.name: Summer Freeze Pre-Pay
offers.tagline: Renew 3M now; travel in June without losing days.
offers.Mechanics: Renew 3M+ in May → 2 extra freeze attempts + 2 guest passes for summer visitors. Stacked: 2 extra freezes, 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: June is a lapse month in Mumbai. Freezes cost nothing and remove the reason to let a membership expire.

hook: Second purchase: converting the flagship cohort
job: Turn the anniversary’s buyers into a habit: eight classes inside thirty days, then the second purchase, before the flagship glow wears off.
moment: April sold the membership; this month sells the second one. The renewal stream is built on usage — a thirty-day plan, an upgrade path for anyone who is ready for a longer term, and a winback for the buyers who never came back.

offers.name: Home for the Summer
offers.tagline: Back in town? Train with us till you fly.
offers.Mechanics: 2-week unlimited newcomer at list. Buy a 1M before leaving → 1 virtual private to keep going abroad.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹4.2L counted (−₹66.9k vs the ₹4.9L stream plan) · 26 buyers
offers.Why it works: Summer brings back students and NRIs who can't commit long-term. Virtual privates keep them connected until they return.
offers.Model: 116 in pool × 20.7% plan rate × 1.10 conversion factor = 26.4 buyers × ₹16k ticket (70% take the featured product) = ₹4.2L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Golden Hours Student Pass
offers.tagline: Students and under-25s: 20% off, in the classes with room.
offers.Commercial job: Fill low-fill slots with a new audience
offers.Mechanics: Students / under-25 with ID: 8-class pack at 20% off, valid only weekday 10–12 and weekend 4–7 pm classes.
offers.Why it works: Those slots run at 27–41% fill (Kenkere weekend 4–7 pm 27%, Bandra 29%). There are no weekday afternoon classes, so the pass uses slots that already run. Restricting slots stops cannibalisation of the 8–10 am crowd.
offers.What to watch: Check ID; Golden Hours bookings vs capacity.

offers.name: Bring Your Dad
offers.tagline: the second seat: Strength Lab for two.
offers.Commercial job: Duo acquisition for a new audience
offers.Mechanics: Father + child first-timers: both buy a 12-class pack+ within 72 hours → standing 15% each + a shared 30-min duo private. Kwality routes to Barre/powerCycle off-peak (Strength Lab is 69% full).
offers.Why it works: Opens a male audience through a family moment, using the same duo mechanic.
offers.What to watch: Strength Lab peak capacity at Kwality.

offers.name: Out of Office, Not Out of Shape
offers.tagline: Freeze when you fly. Train when you're home.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed clients: standing 15% on 1M + 2 extra freezes + a written travel workout plan.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹3.9L counted (+₹57.4k vs the ₹3.3L stream plan) · 49 buyers
offers.Why it works: Removes the "I'll be away" objection without cash.
offers.Model: 607 in pool × 8.1% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 49.0 buyers × ₹8k ticket (23% take the featured product) = ₹3.9L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Pay-As-You-Return
offers.tagline: Start with 4. If you're back, it all counts.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed clients buy a 4-class pack at list. Buy a 12-class pack within 14 days → the full 4-pack price is credited against it.
offers.Why it works: Lowest barrier to return, and the credit pulls them onto a 12-pack. Bandra's reactivation rate is the lowest in the group (2.8% a month).

offers.name: Summer Semester Return
offers.tagline: Golden Hours, for returning students.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed students / under-25s: Golden Hours 8-class pack at 20%.
offers.Why it works: Same slot logic as the student pass, aimed at lapsed young clients.

offers.name: Freeze, Don't Leave
offers.tagline: Renew now; pause when you travel.
offers.Mechanics: June renewers on 3M+ get 2 extra freeze attempts; pack renewers get validity +7 days.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹16.8L counted (+₹1.3L vs the ₹15.5L stream plan) · 78 buyers
offers.Why it works: Freezes cost no cash and answer the top summer objection.
offers.Model: 133 in pool × 57.1% plan rate × 1.03 conversion factor = 78.3 buyers × ₹21.5k ticket = ₹16.8L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Passport Membership
offers.tagline: Renew 3M and train with us from anywhere.
offers.Mechanics: Renew 3M+ → 1 virtual private for use while travelling.
offers.Why it works: Virtual privates keep the habit through travel; effective ≈8%.

offers.name: Pass the Baton
offers.tagline: Renew, and gift a student their first class.
offers.Mechanics: Renew at list; get a free Golden Hours class to gift to a student.
offers.Why it works: Zero-discount renewal with a referral built in.

hook: Retention: dated freezes instead of cancellations
job: Protect the book: convert cancellation intent into dated freezes, keep the direct debits alive, and hold intake with a low-commitment newcomer offer.
moment: Retention is the revenue stream. A freeze with a return date replaces the cancellation, the renewal ladder runs early so nothing lapses by default, and a short-ticket newcomer offer keeps the front door open while the book is held.

offers.name: Rain Check
offers.tagline: Showed up in the rain? That counts.
offers.Commercial job: the low-attendance stretch acquisition with a story
offers.Mechanics: Trials on red/orange-alert days are free. Buy 3M within 72 hours at standing 15% + a P57 umbrella.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹6.1L counted (+₹1.1L vs the ₹5.0L stream plan) · 21 buyers
offers.Why it works: the low-attendance stretch gives a visual hook. The umbrella is the retail item; only 3M qualifies so effective stays ≤20%.
offers.Model: 100 in pool × 21.0% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 21.0 buyers × ₹28.8k ticket (40% take the featured product) = ₹6.1L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: The Streak Starter
offers.tagline: 12 classes, no late cancels, one bonus.
offers.Commercial job: Build attendance discipline from day one
offers.Mechanics: 12-class pack at 12% + earned: 12 classes and zero late cancels in 30 days → 1 bonus class.
offers.Why it works: Kenkere's late-cancel rate hit 25–30% in Jun–Aug 2026. Teaching new clients the rule early is cheaper than enforcing it later.

offers.name: Indoor Season Pass
offers.tagline: The the low-attendance stretch lasts two months. So does this.
offers.Mechanics: 2-month unlimited at 12% off (Mumbai ≈₹35.6k, Bengaluru ≈₹25.7k).
offers.Why it works: A middle step between 1M and 3M timed to the season.

offers.name: Rain or Shine Comeback
offers.tagline: Come in from the rain.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed clients: standing 15% on 1M + comeback class; 3M buyers get the umbrella.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹4.6L counted (+₹53.4k vs the ₹4.0L stream plan) · 51 buyers
offers.Why it works: Indoor exercise is the easy sell when outdoor plans wash out.
offers.Model: 638 in pool × 8.0% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 51.0 buyers × ₹8.9k ticket (23% take the featured product) = ₹4.6L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Reunion Saturday
offers.tagline: One hosted class, all your old faces.
offers.Mechanics: Saturday hosted class for lapsed clients (weekend 8–12 runs 52–63% full). Encore: 8-class pack at 15% within 7 days.
offers.Why it works: Saturdays are the strongest slots; a reunion fills them with buyers.

offers.name: Dry Spell Over
offers.tagline: It's been a while. Freezes included.
offers.Mechanics: Standing 15% on a 12-class pack + 2 extra freezes for the low-attendance stretch disruption. Stacked: 2 extra freezes.
offers.Why it works: Older lapsers need reassurance more than discount.

offers.name: Midyear Report Card
offers.tagline: Your half-year, in numbers.
offers.Mechanics: Personal half-year stats + trainer review; renew the prescribed product at list → 2 guest passes.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹20.5L counted (+₹1.7L vs the ₹18.8L stream plan) · 81 buyers
offers.Why it works: A mid-year version of Wrapped that moves members to the right product.
offers.Model: 129 in pool × 61.2% plan rate × 1.03 conversion factor = 81.4 buyers × ₹25.2k ticket = ₹20.5L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: The Streak
offers.tagline: 12+ classes, zero late cancels, +7 days.
offers.Commercial job: Cut late cancels and lift renewals
offers.Mechanics: Renew in July; 12+ classes and zero late cancels in the month → +7 days (unlimited) or +1 class (packs).
offers.Why it works: Fixes behaviour and revenue together. Bandra's late-cancel spike was fixed by enforcement in 2025, so the rule works when it's visible.

offers.name: Late-Cancel Amnesty
offers.tagline: Renew on time and we wipe your late-cancel fees.
offers.Mechanics: Renew by T-7: outstanding late-cancel fees waived; opt into T-12h reminders.
offers.Why it works: Fees owed are a common silent reason not to renew. Fee data is not in the exports, so the cost is an estimate.

hook: Engagement as the leading indicator of renewal
job: Hold attendance so the renewals that fall due actually land: streaks, grace on late cancels, and a renewal priced before the drop.
moment: Renewal is decided weeks after attendance moves, so the month’s offers are behavioural rather than financial: a streak that makes showing up visible, a small grace on late cancels, and a renewal ladder sold to people who are still coming.

offers.name: Friends Who Squat Together
offers.tagline: Trial together, join together, bonus together.
offers.Mechanics: Two first-timers who trial together and both buy within 72 hours: 12-class pack at 12% + 1 bonus class each.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹6.1L counted (+₹30k vs the ₹5.8L stream plan) · 28 buyers
offers.Why it works: the squad window hook. Duo buyers are both new by design.
offers.Model: 109 in pool × 22.0% plan rate × 1.15 conversion factor = 27.6 buyers × ₹22.2k ticket (60% take the featured product) = ₹6.1L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Squad of Three
offers.tagline: Three friends, one shared private.
offers.Mechanics: Three first-timers buy 12-class packs together: standing 15% each + one shared 30-min private for the squad.
offers.Why it works: Kenkere's walk-ins and WhatsApp leads convert best (44% and 28%); groups bring their own accountability.

offers.name: Upgrade on Day 1
offers.tagline: Started on 1M? Upgrade in 14 days and it all counts.
offers.Mechanics: New clients who buy 1M and upgrade to 3M within 14 days: 1M price fully credited, standing 15% applies to the 3M.
offers.Why it works: Lowers the first decision and still lands the 3M. 3M renews at 68–74%.

offers.name: Second Peak Homecoming
offers.tagline: A personal call, a private, and your 3 months back.
offers.Mechanics: ≥₹50k lifetime lapsed clients: manager call; 3M at standing 15% + one 30-min private.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹4.5L counted (+₹98.3k vs the ₹3.5L stream plan) · 42 buyers
offers.Why it works: Kwality has 87 high-value clients lapsed 61–365 days; August is its second peak.
offers.Model: 554 in pool × 7.9% plan rate × 0.95 conversion factor = 41.8 buyers × ₹10.8k ticket (14% take the featured product) = ₹4.5L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Old Friends
offers.tagline: Your friend misses you in class.
offers.Mechanics: Active members invite a lapsed friend: lapsed gets standing 15% on a 12-class pack + comeback class; member gets 2 bonus classes when they buy.
offers.Why it works: A message from a friend beats one from the studio.

offers.name: More Time, Same Pack
offers.tagline: 12 classes, 90 days to use them.
offers.Mechanics: Standing 15% on a 12-class pack with validity doubled to 90 days.
offers.Why it works: Validity is the common complaint of lapsed pack users; extra time on a pack costs no classes.

offers.name: Trade-Up
offers.tagline: Going 3 months? Your remaining days come with you, plus a week.
offers.Mechanics: 1M renewers with 8+ visits a month → 3M: remaining days carried over + 7 bonus days.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹27.4L counted (+₹5.3L vs the ₹22.1L stream plan) · 91 buyers
offers.Why it works: 3M renews at 68–74% vs 53–59% for 1M. Bandra already upgrades 26% of renewals.
offers.Model: 143 in pool × 63.6% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 91.0 buyers × ₹30.2k ticket (35% take the featured product) = ₹27.4L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Pack Ladder
offers.tagline: Move to 20 and get 2 more.
offers.Mechanics: 12-class renewers → 20-class pack at list + 2 bonus classes.
offers.Why it works: 20+ packs renew at 81% at Kwality, the highest of any product.

offers.name: Friendship Renewal
offers.tagline: Renew and bring a friend in.
offers.Mechanics: Renew at list; friend buys → +7 days or +1 class.
offers.Why it works: Referral ask at the happiest moment.

hook: Term ladder: 1M → 3M → 6M
job: Move the one-month book onto longer terms — the same member at a longer commitment, not a cheaper one — and fill the new seats by referral.
moment: The upgrade path is the growth stream. One month becomes three, three becomes six, each priced on commitment; a squad referral brings in the new seats without a discount, and winback returns the lapsed to the same ladder.

offers.name: The 57-Day Cohort
offers.tagline: 2 Sep to 28 Oct. Finish strong before the festivities.
offers.Commercial job: Cohort acquisition that carries attendance into October
offers.Mechanics: 2-month unlimited at 12% + challenge kit: weekly check-ins, finale class; finishers (40+ classes) get a end-of-year retail gift.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹6.4L counted (+₹31.4k vs the ₹6.1L stream plan) · 21 buyers
offers.Why it works: The 57 is the brand. A fixed finish line before the gifting window gives a deadline and fills October, Kenkere's weakest month.
offers.What to watch: Finisher rate; renewals at end of October.
offers.Model: 96 in pool × 21.9% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 21.0 buyers × ₹30.5k ticket (45% take the featured product) = ₹6.4L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Gift Ready 12
offers.tagline: 12 classes, 60 days, guests welcome.
offers.Mechanics: 12-class pack at standing 15% with validity 60 days (vs 45) + 2 guest passes for end-of-year visitors. Stacked: +15 days validity, 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: Longer validity solves end-of-year travel; guest passes create leads.

offers.name: Bring-a-Friend Trial Week
offers.tagline: Book a 7am or 7pm trial and bring a friend free.
offers.Mechanics: Trials in morning/evening slots: 2-for-1 intro; standing 15% on purchase.
offers.Why it works: Evening and morning trials convert 11–17%; afternoon trials 1–7%.

offers.name: The Return Policy
offers.tagline: Come back within 7 days of your comeback class and get a bonus.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed 61–365 days: standing 15% + comeback class; 3M within 7 days → +1 bonus class.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹6.0L counted (+₹1.5L vs the ₹4.5L stream plan) · 47 buyers
offers.Why it works: Approved 2027 playbook offer; time-limited to keep decisions fast.
offers.Model: 593 in pool × 7.9% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 47.0 buyers × ₹12.8k ticket (16% take the featured product) = ₹6.0L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: We Kept Your Spot
offers.tagline: A personal note from your favourite trainer.
offers.Mechanics: Message from the client's most-booked trainer with a reserved spot in their class; standing 15% on a 12-class pack.
offers.Why it works: Trainer relationships are what clients miss. Bandra repeats the Class of 2024 Reunion this month too.

offers.name: 57-Day Comeback
offers.tagline: Join the the gifting window challenge as a returning member.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed clients join 57 Days to the gifting window: 2-month unlimited at 15% + end-of-year retail gift on finishing.
offers.Why it works: Puts returning clients into a group with a finish line.

offers.name: Gift Lock-in
offers.tagline: Renew 3M; the gifting window week pause included.
offers.Mechanics: Renew 3M+ in September → 1 extra freeze for the gifting window week + end-of-year retail gift.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹26.4L counted (+₹4.4L vs the ₹22.1L stream plan) · 78 buyers
offers.Why it works: October–December are troughs; locking 3M now carries members through them.
offers.Model: 169 in pool × 45.0% plan rate × 1.02 conversion factor = 77.5 buyers × ₹34.1k ticket (35% take the featured product) = ₹26.4L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Challenge Captain
offers.tagline: Bring two friends into the challenge, get two weeks.
offers.Mechanics: Renewers who bring 2 friends into 57 Days to the gifting window get +14 days (unlimited) or +2 classes (packs).
offers.Why it works: Kenkere's renewal base is strong; using it to recruit fixes its weak acquisition.

offers.name: Usage Prescription (Q3)
offers.tagline: Your next 3 months, sized to how you train.
offers.Mechanics: T-14 usage-based renewal; 8+ visits → 3M + 7 days.
offers.Why it works: Repeats the evidence-based script.

hook: Reactivation at scale, one start date
job: Reactivate the lapsed book at scale with one cohort, one start date and one finish line, so the comeback is a habit rather than a message.
moment: Reactivation carries the month. A cohort winback with a fixed start date gives the comeback a deadline and a peer group, the newcomer trial rides the same date to share the energy, and the renewal ladder steps the book into the final quarter.

offers.name: Gift a Shake
offers.Commercial job: Gift-led revenue that brings new clients
offers.Mechanics: Gift cards with 10% bonus value (Mumbai ₹20,000 → ₹22,000; Bengaluru ₹15,000 → ₹16,500). Recipients enter the newcomer flow.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹6.1L counted (−₹1.3L vs the ₹7.4L stream plan) · 24 buyers
offers.Why it works: the gifting window gifting is real spend that doesn't need a discount. Kwality has a late-October surge (38% of sales after the 21st). Revenue is booked when the card is sold.
offers.What to watch: Redemption by new vs existing clients.
offers.Model: 109 in pool × 22.0% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 24.0 buyers × ₹25.4k ticket (100% take the featured product) = ₹6.1L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Festival of Lights Evenings
offers.tagline: Candle-lit evening classes, the gifting window week.
offers.Commercial job: Hosted acquisition with a door offer
offers.Mechanics: Candle-lit 7 pm classes (46–55% fill) open to first-timers. Encore: 3M at standing 15% + end-of-year retail gift.
offers.Why it works: A memorable first class; the door offer is what converts.

offers.name: The Duo Credit
offers.tagline: Two first months, one end-of-year box.
offers.Mechanics: Two first-timers both buy 1M at 10% + one shared end-of-year box.
offers.Why it works: Lower cash discount than the standing perk, offset by the box and the pair.

offers.name: The Homecoming Invitation
offers.tagline: Your mat's still here.
offers.Mechanics: Standing 15% on a 12-class pack + comeback class in the gifting window week.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹5.3L counted (+₹62.5k vs the ₹4.7L stream plan) · 48 buyers
offers.Why it works: Simple and on-theme.
offers.Model: 573 in pool × 8.0% plan rate × 1.05 conversion factor = 48.3 buyers × ₹11k ticket (25% take the featured product) = ₹5.3L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Light Up Your Streak
offers.tagline: 15 classes in 30 days lights up 3 extra days.
offers.Mechanics: 1M at 12%; 15 classes in 30 days → +3 days.
offers.Why it works: Kenkere's the quiet week trough needs attendance as much as sales.

offers.name: Advance Credit
offers.tagline: ₹2,000 end-of-year credit on 3 months.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed clients: standing 15% on 3M + ₹2,000 end-of-year credit (retail or classes).
offers.Why it works: Moves reactivations up from ₹5–8k to a 3M.

offers.name: Credit in Advance
offers.tagline: Renew in October, get 5% back to gift.
offers.Mechanics: Renew at list → 5% back as credit usable only on a Gift a Shake card.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹30.4L counted (+₹88.6k vs the ₹29.5L stream plan) · 99 buyers
offers.Why it works: Turns renewal value into new-client acquisition.
offers.Model: 122 in pool × 78.7% plan rate × 1.03 conversion factor = 98.9 buyers × ₹30.8k ticket = ₹30.4L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Gift Pause Pass
offers.tagline: Renew now; pause for the holidays.
offers.Mechanics: Renew 1M+ → 1 extra freeze for end-of-year travel + 2 guest passes for family. Stacked: 1 extra freeze, 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: Kenkere's October (₹4.8L in 2025) is a travel trough; freezes keep members from lapsing.

offers.name: Limited Run: First Access
offers.tagline: A new format, six weeks only. Renewed members book first.
offers.Commercial job: Newness as a reason to renew
offers.Mechanics: Renewers get 48-hour first access to the quarter's limited-run format + 1 bonus format class.
offers.Why it works: A restaurant-style seasonal menu: novelty drives return visits without touching price.

hook: Gifting as a revenue stream, not a promotion
job: Add revenue that survives the month — gift cards, gifting annuals and a second annual wave — with no promo-code discounting.
moment: Gifting is a stream, not a sale: cards and gift annuals are priced and banked, a second numbered-annual wave takes the commitment buyers, and winback returns the lapsed on the strength of the gift rather than a cut.

offers.name: The Annual Window
offers.tagline: 26–29 Nov only: 3 months + a week.
offers.Mechanics: 26–29 Nov: 3M at 15% + 7 extra days.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹4.4L counted (+₹99.3k vs the ₹3.5L stream plan) · 16 buyers
offers.Why it works: November is the softest Mumbai month. A 4-day window is expected and needs no deeper %.
offers.What to watch: Effective ≈22.8%: above the 15% 3M+ guardrail but under the 25% cap.
offers.Model: 70 in pool × 22.9% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 16.0 buyers × ₹27.8k ticket (45% take the featured product) = ₹4.4L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: The Annual Six
offers.tagline: Six months, one private, 15% off.
offers.Mechanics: 6M at 15% + 1 private.
offers.Why it works: 6M renews at 63–77%; a premium first purchase for decided buyers.

offers.name: The Envelope
offers.tagline: First 57 buyers open an envelope.
offers.Mechanics: First 57 new buyers of a 12-class pack+: standing 15% + mystery envelope.
offers.Why it works: Scarcity count creates urgency; the envelope stays a small extra.

offers.name: High-Value Homecoming
offers.tagline: A manager call and six months with a private.
offers.Commercial job: Win back the most valuable lapsers
offers.Mechanics: ≥₹50k lifetime lapsed: manager call; 6M at standing 15% + 1 private.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹2.9L counted (+₹64k vs the ₹2.3L stream plan) · 29 buyers
offers.Why it works: Kwality and Bandra have 139 high-value lapsed clients between them.
offers.Model: 400 in pool × 8.0% plan rate × 0.90 conversion factor = 28.8 buyers × ₹10.2k ticket (7% take the featured product) = ₹2.9L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: The Annual Envelope
offers.tagline: Back for 3 months + a week.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed: 3M at 15% + 7 days, 26–29 Nov.
offers.Why it works: Same window as the new-client offer, one message for both audiences.

offers.name: The Last-Chance List
offers.tagline: Before the year ends, one more go.
offers.Mechanics: 61–365-day lapsed: standing 15% on a 12-class pack with 90-day validity.
offers.Why it works: Validity across the holidays is the value.

offers.name: The Founding 57: Second Wave
offers.tagline: The last numbered seats.
offers.Mechanics: Remaining Founding 57 seats only, same Founders' kit.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹14.1L counted (+₹2.2L vs the ₹11.9L stream plan) · 55 buyers
offers.Why it works: Second wave closes the scarcity story; no new seats are created.
offers.Model: 88 in pool × 62.5% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 55.0 buyers × ₹25.6k ticket (4% take the featured product) = ₹14.1L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Annual Window Renewals
offers.tagline: Renew long in the the annual window window.
offers.Mechanics: Renew in the window: 3M +7 days, 6M +14 days, Annual +30 days.
offers.Why it works: Ladder rewards length, not depth.

offers.name: Renew Early, Gift a Class
offers.tagline: Renew before 30 Nov and gift a friend a class.
offers.Mechanics: Renew before 30 Nov → 1 class gift card for a friend.
offers.Why it works: No price change; a referral built in.

hook: Annual commitments, capped and dated
job: Take the year’s biggest commitment window without discounting the year: capped numbered annuals, a closed date, and a renewal ladder on the expiring book.
moment: The annual is the offer. A second wave of numbered memberships opens to the list first and closes on a date, the renewal ladder re-signs whatever comes due, and winback catches anyone who let a membership lapse during the year.

offers.name: The Pre-Solution
offers.tagline: Buy in December, start any day until 15 January.
offers.Mechanics: 3M at standing 15% + flexible start until 15 Jan + 2 extra freezes + January kickoff consult.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹5.7L counted (+₹90.8k vs the ₹4.8L stream plan) · 19 buyers
offers.Why it works: Moves January demand into December cash (Kenkere's December is ₹5.3–6.5L).
offers.Model: 94 in pool × 20.2% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 19.0 buyers × ₹30.1k ticket (40% take the featured product) = ₹5.7L modelled; 100% of uplift counted
offers.Stacked perks: flexible start · 2 extra freezes · kickoff consult

offers.name: Gift the Habit
offers.tagline: A year-end gift that lasts.
offers.Mechanics: Gift cards with 10% bonus value.
offers.Why it works: Second gifting window after the gifting window.

offers.name: 12 Days of Shakemas
offers.tagline: A different perk every day for 12 days.
offers.Commercial job: Daily urgency in a slow month
offers.Mechanics: 12–23 Dec: each day a new single-day perk on 12-class pack+ purchases (guest passes, bottle, freeze, consult…), average value ₹1,000, on top of the standing 15%.
offers.Why it works: Daily content and a reason to buy today.

offers.name: Your 2027 Wrapped (lapsed edition)
offers.tagline: You took 87 classes with us. Here's to 2028.
offers.Mechanics: Personal stats page (classes, favourite trainer, best month) + comeback class + standing 15% on a 12-class pack.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹6.3L counted (+₹1.2L vs the ₹5.1L stream plan) · 67 buyers
offers.Why it works: People share year-in-review pages. It reminds lapsed clients of their own habit.
offers.What to watch: Needs a stats export per client.
offers.Model: 758 in pool × 8.0% plan rate × 1.10 conversion factor = 67.1 buyers × ₹9.4k ticket (25% take the featured product) = ₹6.3L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Pre-Solution Comeback
offers.tagline: Buy now, restart in January.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed: 1M at standing 15% with a start date up to 15 Jan. Stacked: flexible start.
offers.Why it works: Captures intent before the the year start noise.

offers.name: The Guest List
offers.tagline: Family's in town. Bring them.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed: standing 15% on a 12-class pack + 2 guest passes for holiday visitors. Stacked: 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: Guests become January leads.

offers.name: 2027 Wrapped → 2028 Prescription
offers.tagline: Your year in numbers, and the plan for next year.
offers.Mechanics: Personal year-in-review page ending in a renewal prescription. Renew the prescribed product within 7 days → +1 class (packs) / +5 days (unlimited).
offers.Expected revenue: ₹21.1L counted (+₹2.1L vs the ₹19.0L stream plan) · 79 buyers
offers.Why it works: The restaurateur's "love-letter bill": the renewal script the data supports, presented as something clients want to share.
offers.Model: 105 in pool × 71.4% plan rate × 1.05 conversion factor = 78.8 buyers × ₹26.9k ticket = ₹21.1L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Early-Bird Annual
offers.tagline: Renew 6M or annual in December, get January free.
offers.Commercial job: Long renewals before the year turns
offers.Mechanics: 6M or Annual renewal at list + 30 days.
offers.Why it works: Locks the best clients before January choices.

offers.name: The 100 Club
offers.tagline: 100+ classes this year? You're in the club.
offers.Mechanics: Members with 100+ classes in 2027: Members' Circle perks + one trainer session on renewal at list.
offers.Why it works: The top 10% of clients make 54–60% of class revenue; recognition costs little.

hook: Data-led renewal and the January pre-sale
job: Renew on usage: every member’s own year in data, ending in a renewal prescription — then pre-sell January before the calendar resets.
moment: The renewal stream closes the year. A personal year-in-review is the argument, a prescription renewal is the ask, the gifting tail carries into January, and the pre-sale takes next year’s annuals before the discount season can argue against them.

offers.name: 21 in 21 Kickstart
offers.tagline: 21 days unlimited. Hit 15 classes and the fee comes off your 3M.
offers.Commercial job: Low-risk entry that filters for habit, then upgrades
offers.Mechanics: 21-day unlimited intro (Mumbai ₹10,500, Bengaluru ₹8,399 — Kenkere already sells "The 21-Day Trial"). Attend 15+ classes → the full fee is credited against a 3M bought within 7 days of the end (≈18–20% on the 3M).
offers.Expected revenue: ₹3.1L counted (+₹37.7k vs the ₹2.7L stream plan) · 20 buyers
offers.Why it works: Kenkere's problem is conversion: 3.4% lead→commitment, website leads reach a trial 7.5% of the time. A cheap, time-boxed entry gets more people to commit to something, and the 15-class gate selects the clients who will renew. Revenue shown is the kickstart fee only; the 3M follow-on is upside.
offers.What to watch: Kickstart → 3M conversion (target 35%). Cap the 3M credit so effective discount on the 3M stays ≤20%.
offers.Model: 87 in pool × 17.2% plan rate × 1.35 conversion factor = 20.3 buyers × ₹15.2k ticket (75% take the featured product) = ₹3.1L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: The Habit Refund
offers.tagline: Show up 36 times in 90 days and we pay you back.
offers.Commercial job: Raise first-purchase value and build the early habit
offers.Mechanics: Pay 3M at list within 72 hours of the trial (instead of the standing 15% now). Attend 36 classes in the first 90 days → 20% of the price back as studio credit, valid 60 days for the next purchase.
offers.Why it works: Clients choose between 15% now or 20% later if they show up. Committed buyers pick the refund, and the credit can only be spent on a second purchase, which is where loyalty forms (first purchases renew at 40–45%, repeat renewals at 64–68%). Usage is the strongest renewal predictor in the data (fully used 62% vs under-half 22%).
offers.What to watch: Earn rate (plan for ~40% earning, so the real cost is ~8%). Credit redemption within 60 days.

offers.name: Habit Insurance
offers.tagline: Commit for 3 months. Life happens; your membership waits.
offers.Commercial job: Remove the "what if I travel or get sick" objection to 3M
offers.Mechanics: 3M at the standing 15% + stacked: 2 extra freeze attempts, a 15-minute goal-setting consult with a trainer, 2 guest passes for friends. Stacked: 2 extra freezes, 15-min trainer consult, 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: Same cash cost as the standing perk, but the stack makes the 3M feel safe. 3M renews at 68–74% vs 53–59% for 1M, so moving first buyers up the ladder is worth more than the discount.
offers.What to watch: Share of January new buyers on 3M+ (target ≥45%).

offers.name: An Old Friend
offers.tagline: A comeback class, a plan, and the 15% you already have.
offers.Commercial job: Baseline lapsed sequence with a human touch
offers.Mechanics: Standing 15% on an 8-class pack or bigger + free comeback class + 15-minute "reset" consult with a trainer and a 2-week attendance plan. Clients with ≥₹50k lifetime spend get a manager call.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹2.3L counted (+₹17.2k vs the ₹2.2L stream plan) · 33 buyers
offers.Why it works: Keeps the cash cost at the standing perk and adds structure. Reactivations earn ₹4.8–8.3k each, so personal calls go only to the high-value group.
offers.What to watch: Reactivation rate of the 61–365-day pool (Bandra 2.8% → 3.4% a month).
offers.Model: 419 in pool × 7.9% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 33.0 buyers × ₹7k ticket (23% take the featured product) = ₹2.3L modelled; 100% of uplift counted
offers.Stacked perks: comeback class · 15-min reset consult · 2-week attendance plan

offers.name: Unfinished Business
offers.tagline: You left 2 classes behind. We kept them.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed clients who let credits expire get up to 2 of them reinstated when they buy a 12-class pack or bigger. Replaces the standing 15% (not stacked).
offers.Why it works: Endowment effect: people value "their" lost classes more than an equal discount. It also reaches the under-used clients (packs used under 50% renew at 22–24%) with a reason to return.
offers.What to watch: Only clients with expired unused credits. Bengaluru effective ≈21.6%.

offers.name: The Second Chance
offers.tagline: 36 days for the price of 30.
offers.Commercial job: Catch December lapsers before the habit is gone
offers.Mechanics: Clients lapsed 0–90 days after Nov–Dec: 1M at list + 6 extra days. Valid 2–20 Jan.
offers.Why it works: Recent lapsers return fastest; time is cheaper than cash at 42–45% fill. Effective 20%, the cap for ≤1M products.
offers.What to watch: Restrict to 0–90 days lapsed so it doesn't pull forward active renewals.

offers.name: Usage Prescription
offers.tagline: We looked at your last 3 months. Here's the plan that fits.
offers.Commercial job: Rebuild the renewal ticket with data
offers.Mechanics: T-14 call with a usage-based recommendation: 8+ visits a month on 1M → 3M at list + 7 days; under 50% used → a smaller pack + attendance plan. 2 guest passes for renewing on the prescribed product within 7 days.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹13.0L counted (+₹1.5L vs the ₹11.5L stream plan) · 52 buyers
offers.Why it works: Bandra's ticket fell ₹24.3k → ₹21.2k from mix drift, not refusals. Usage-based advice moves 8+-visit members up and keeps light users from lapsing.
offers.Model: 60 in pool × 83.3% plan rate × 1.03 conversion factor = 51.5 buyers × ₹25.3k ticket = ₹13.0L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: The Re-Up Ladder
offers.tagline: The longer you commit, the bigger the thank-you.
offers.Commercial job: Renew at list and push the ticket up
offers.Mechanics: Renew at list: 1M +1 class, 3M +7 days, 6M +14 days, Annual +30 days and a Members' Circle invite. No % off.
offers.Why it works: Full-price renewers renew again at 61–68% vs 50–54% after discounts. The ladder rewards upgrades (20–26% of renewals already upgrade) without training clients to wait for codes.
offers.What to watch: Renewal ticket vs plan (KH ₹24.0k, SHQ ₹21.7k, KK ₹14.3k).

offers.name: Go Long in January
offers.tagline: 6 months or a year, plus a month on us.
offers.Mechanics: 6M or Annual renewal at list + 30 extra days. Annual renewers also get the standing annual perks.
offers.Why it works: Jan-2026 sold 8 annuals (₹12.5L) that come due now. Long commitments retain best (6M 63–77%, annual 71%).
offers.What to watch: Effective 16.7% on 6M, 8.2% on Annual — within the 3M+ cap only for annual; keep 6M to +21 days if strict.

hook: Renewal book + full-price trial conversion
job: Re-up the expiring annual book at full value, convert trial demand at full price, and reactivate the lapsed — without setting a discount anchor for the year.
moment: The month is built from three revenue streams. Renewals carry it: an annual book comes due and is re-signed in a ladder of longer terms. New clients convert from trial at list, with a refund-of-habit mechanism instead of a price cut. Winback works the lapsed list with a single, honest comeback offer.

offers.name: The Duo Rate
offers.tagline: Trial together, start together, train together.
offers.Commercial job: Two genuinely new clients per sale
offers.Mechanics: Two first-timers who trial together and both buy a 12-class pack+ within 72 hours: standing 15% each + one shared 30-minute duo private.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹2.4L counted (+₹41.4k vs the ₹2.0L stream plan) · 16 buyers
offers.Why it works: Replaces BOGO, which went mostly to existing clients (6–21% new) and renewed at 33–53%. Only two new clients unlock it, and referrals convert at 25% at Kwality.
offers.What to watch: Both buyers must be new. Effective ≈21.7% Mumbai, 22.9% Bengaluru.
offers.Model: 81 in pool × 17.3% plan rate × 1.15 conversion factor = 16.1 buyers × ₹14.8k ticket (55% take the featured product) = ₹2.4L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Love Language Menu
offers.tagline: Pick the perk that says it best.
offers.Mechanics: New 3M+ buyers: standing 15% + choose one: Quality Time (30-min private), Gifts (retail item), Acts of Service (2 extra freezes + priority booking), Words (written 12-week plan from a trainer).
offers.Why it works: Choice increases perceived value at no extra cost; every option is worth less than a 30-minute private. Only 3M+ qualifies, which pulls the first ticket toward ₹42–49k.
offers.What to watch: Track which perk is chosen; it tells you what new clients value.

offers.name: Plus-One, Minus Excuses
offers.tagline: Bring a friend. When they join, you both win.
offers.Mechanics: Friend: newcomer intro + standing 15%. Referrer: 2 bonus classes when the friend buys a commitment product.
offers.Why it works: Referral is the cheapest channel with 25% conversion at Kwality. The referrer bonus is acquisition cost, not a discount to the buyer.

offers.name: Come Back as a Pair
offers.tagline: Return with a friend. Their first class is on us.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed client returns at standing 15% on a 12-class pack; brings a friend for a free intro. If the friend buys, the lapsed client gets 2 guest passes and 48-hour priority booking.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹1.7L counted (+₹48.1k vs the ₹1.2L stream plan) · 25 buyers
offers.Why it works: Two streams from one message: reactivation and a warm new lead. Rewards are seats and access, so the cash cost stays at 15%.
offers.What to watch: Friends who buy (counts as new-client revenue).
offers.Model: 285 in pool × 8.1% plan rate × 1.10 conversion factor = 25.3 buyers × ₹6.6k ticket (25% take the featured product) = ₹1.7L modelled; 100% of uplift counted
offers.Stacked perks: friend intro · 2 guest passes · priority booking

offers.name: We Need to Talk
offers.tagline: It's not you. It was our schedule. Let's try again.
offers.Mechanics: Break-up letter themed message. Standing 15% on 1M + comeback class + 2 extra freezes so they can't "break up" again over travel. Stacked: comeback class, 2 extra freezes.
offers.Why it works: the pair gives a story without a deeper discount. Freezes answer the most common lapse reason without cash.

offers.name: The Reunion Class
offers.tagline: One Saturday, all your old class friends.
offers.Commercial job: Turn a hosted class into reactivations
offers.Mechanics: Hosted reunion class Sat 13 Feb for lapsed clients. Encore QR at the door: 12-class pack at 12% + 1 bonus class within 7 days.
offers.Why it works: Hosted visits convert at 1–3% without a door offer; the Encore mechanic with a named associate is what lifts them.
offers.What to watch: Conversion at the door (target 10% of attendees).

offers.name: Better Together Renewals
offers.tagline: Renew and bring someone in.
offers.Mechanics: Renew at list; if a friend you refer buys in February, +7 days (unlimited) or +1 class (packs).
offers.Expected revenue: ₹12.1L counted (+₹23.8k vs the ₹11.9L stream plan) · 67 buyers
offers.Why it works: Renewal moments are when clients are happiest; ask for the referral then.
offers.Model: 66 in pool × 100.0% plan rate × 1.02 conversion factor = 67.3 buyers × ₹18k ticket = ₹12.1L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: The Couple's Plan
offers.tagline: Renew with your workout partner.
offers.Mechanics: Two members renewing 3M+ together: 5% off each + one shared 30-minute duo private.
offers.Why it works: Pairs keep each other attending, and attendance predicts renewal. A hypothesis to test: tag pair renewals and compare their next renewal rate.
offers.What to watch: Next-renewal rate of pairs vs singles (data gap until tagged).

offers.name: Usage Prescription
offers.tagline: Your renewal, sized to how you actually train.
offers.Mechanics: T-14 usage-based recommendation: 8+ visits on 1M → 3M at list + 7 days; under 50% used → smaller pack + plan.
offers.Why it works: Same evidence as January: mix drift lowered the ticket; usage advice reverses it.

hook: Referral-led new client growth
job: Grow new clients through the second seat rather than a discount: the companion membership is the offer, and the first membership is never cut.
moment: New clients are the growth stream this month, and they arrive in pairs. A duo rate prices the second seat, a referral credit pays out in classes rather than cash, and winback returns to the members who left as a pair — so acquisition is bought with product, not with margin.

offers.name: Strong Women Squad
offers.tagline: 4 weeks, one squad, same time every week.
offers.Mechanics: 12-class pack at standing 15% + fixed squad slot, trainer WhatsApp group, week-4 progress check, graduation class.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹3.0L counted (+₹35.1k vs the ₹2.6L stream plan) · 17 buyers
offers.Why it works: Renewers average 6.4 visits in the first half of a membership vs 2.6–3.4 for lapsers. A squad makes those early visits happen.
offers.Model: 86 in pool × 17.4% plan rate × 1.15 conversion factor = 17.3 buyers × ₹17.3k ticket (60% take the featured product) = ₹3.0L modelled; 100% of uplift counted
offers.Stacked perks: squad slot · trainer WhatsApp group · progress check

offers.name: She Moves: Pay It Forward
offers.tagline: Start your 3 months. Gift a woman her first class.
offers.Commercial job: Purpose-led acquisition with a built-in referral
offers.Mechanics: homecoming week week: new 3M+ buyers get the standing 15% + 2 guest passes, and we gift a free class to a woman they nominate (mother, colleague, friend). Gifted classes enter the Encore flow. Stacked: gift class for a nominee, 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: Gives the purchase a story to share. The gifted class is acquisition cost and creates a warm lead.

offers.name: The Pre-Game
offers.tagline: Don't wait for April. Get in early.
offers.Commercial job: Stop March trials waiting for the anniversary
offers.Mechanics: March trials: buy within 72 hours at standing 15% → early access to April's anniversary box + 1 bonus class on 3M. Stacked: early access to April box.
offers.Why it works: March is a trough (Kwality ₹19–20L). Giving March buyers April status removes the reason to delay.

offers.name: Class of 2024 Reunion
offers.tagline: Where it all started. One class, the whole launch crew.
offers.Mechanics: Hosted reunion for clients lapsed 1–2 years (and 61–365). Rebuy within 7 days: 12-class pack at 12% + 1 bonus class.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹2.6L counted (+₹77k vs the ₹1.9L stream plan) · 33 buyers
offers.Why it works: May–Sep 2024 brought 1,000+ first visits at Bandra; 638 are now lapsed 1–2 years. Reaching people who already know the studio is the cheapest reach Bandra has.
offers.What to watch: Reunion RSVPs → attendance → purchase. Repeat in September.
offers.Model: 358 in pool × 8.1% plan rate × 1.15 conversion factor = 33.3 buyers × ₹7.9k ticket (27% take the featured product) = ₹2.6L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Re-Run Your Best Month
offers.tagline: Remember March 2025? 18 classes. Let's beat it.
offers.Mechanics: Message shows the client's best month. 1M at list; match that class count → +6 days.
offers.Why it works: Personal data beats generic offers and sets a goal. The reward is earned, so cost only lands on clients who attend.
offers.What to watch: Needs a per-client best-month field from Momence.

offers.name: The Homecoming
offers.tagline: Come back, and bring her with you.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed clients returning 8–14 Mar: standing 15% on an 8-class pack + a free class to gift a friend. Stacked: gift class for a friend.
offers.Why it works: Simple, on-theme, cash cost unchanged.

offers.name: Lock In Early
offers.tagline: Renew in March, keep April's perks.
offers.Commercial job: Protect Q1 renewals without pull-forward discounts
offers.Mechanics: Members expiring 1 Mar–15 Apr renew at list + 2 bonus classes (packs) or +7 days (unlimited) + first pick of anniversary hosted classes.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹8.4L counted (+₹32.5k vs the ₹8.1L stream plan) · 37 buyers
offers.Why it works: In 2026 ₹36.7L of Kwality's April came from early renewals at 30%+. Giving March renewers bonus time protects the ticket.
offers.Model: 71 in pool × 50.7% plan rate × 1.04 conversion factor = 37.4 buyers × ₹22.6k ticket = ₹8.4L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Pre-Game Upgrade
offers.tagline: Moving up? Your anniversary box ships early.
offers.Mechanics: 1M renewers with 8+ visits a month → 3M at list + anniversary retail item + 2 guest passes. Stacked: 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: 3M renews at 71% at Kenkere vs 59% for 1M. A retail item costs far less than a % code.

offers.name: Spring Reset Check-in
offers.tagline: Renew with a plan, not a discount.
offers.Mechanics: Every March renewal comes with a 15-minute trainer assessment and a programme. Renew now, start up to 14 days later. Stacked: trainer assessment, flexible start date.
offers.Why it works: Zero-discount baseline for studios that don't need a renewal push in March.

hook: Winback of the launch-year book
job: Rebuild the reactivation stream: bring the lapsed launch cohort home on a reunion offer, and close March trials inside the month instead of letting them slide into April.
moment: Reactivation is the month’s growth stream. A reunion-led winback works the oldest cohort on the book, a trial offer closes in-week so demand does not defer, and a renewal ladder protects the first-quarter book while acquisition runs warm rather than loud.

offers.name: Build Your Box
offers.tagline: The bigger your commitment, the bigger the anniversary box.
offers.Commercial job: Higher-value first purchases at a protected price
offers.Mechanics: Standing 15% on everything + a box that grows: 12-pack → shaker bottle; 3M → bottle + 2 guest passes + 15-min consult; 6M → full box + 1 private.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹6.0L counted (+₹1.3L vs the ₹4.7L stream plan) · 24 buyers
offers.Why it works: April lifts every studio 1.35–2.3× as a moment; depth didn't drive it (Bandra doubled its discount and earned less). Value scales with commitment, so the box pulls buyers up without a deeper %.
offers.What to watch: Effective 18.5% (Mumbai) / 19.7% (Bengaluru) on 3M; above the 15% 3M+ guardrail — drop the retail item on 3M if strict.
offers.Model: 136 in pool × 17.6% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 24.0 buyers × ₹24.9k ticket (36% take the featured product) = ₹6.0L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Commitment Issues Pack
offers.tagline: 3 months, 15% off, and two friends on us.
offers.Mechanics: 3M at 15% + 2 guest passes for friends (friends enter the Encore flow). Stacked: 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: The approved 2027 playbook offer: first ticket ≈₹49.2k (Mumbai) / ₹35.9k (Kenkere) at exactly the 15% cap.

offers.name: The 57-Hour Shake-Up
offers.tagline: Trialled in April? You have 57 hours.
offers.Mechanics: Trials in April get a 57-hour window: 12-class pack at standing 15% + a sealed mystery envelope (guaranteed perk: freeze, guest pass, retail item or 30-min private; average value ₹1,000).
offers.Why it works: Median trial-to-purchase is 3 days and 75% convert within 9 days. A short, named window plus a surprise drives the decision. The envelope stays a hidden extra, not the headline, so the brand stays premium.
offers.What to watch: Envelope mix must keep average value ≤₹1,000 (Bengaluru effective ≈22.6%).

offers.name: Text Your Ex-ercise
offers.tagline: Years later, still shaking. You coming?
offers.Commercial job: Reactivate the lapsed in the biggest month
offers.Mechanics: Standing 15% on a 12-class pack + comeback class; rebuy within 7 days → mystery envelope.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹4.9L counted (+₹1.0L vs the ₹3.8L stream plan) · 59 buyers
offers.Why it works: April has the most attention of the year; lapsed clients see the campaign anyway. The 7-day rule keeps the decision fast.
offers.What to watch: Bandra needs 54 reactivations in April from 673 touches.
offers.Model: 673 in pool × 8.0% plan rate × 1.10 conversion factor = 59.4 buyers × ₹8.2k ticket (23% take the featured product) = ₹4.9L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Still Shaking Reunion Week
offers.tagline: An anniversary class just for returning faces.
offers.Commercial job: Hosted reactivation with a door offer
offers.Mechanics: Anniversary hosted class reserved for lapsed clients. Encore at the door: 1M at 15% + 2 guest passes. Stacked: 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: Turns the anniversary into a homecoming. A named associate at the door is mandatory (hosted visits convert at 1.4–2.9% without one).

offers.name: Since Day One
offers.tagline: You first shook with us on 12 Jun 2023. One class for every year.
offers.Mechanics: Message shows the client's first-class date. 12-class pack at list + 1 bonus class per year with us (max 2).
offers.Why it works: Anniversary month, personal anniversary. Loyalty is rewarded in classes, not price.
offers.What to watch: Needs first-visit date per client (available in Day End – New).

offers.name: The Founding 57 · Coronation
offers.tagline: Fifty-seven numbered annual memberships, crowned in a gala: tiers, a founding wall, and a seat that is never sold again.
offers.Commercial job: Sell the flagship of the year: numbered annuals, capped by seat count, closed on the anniversary.
offers.Mechanics: Fifty-seven numbered annual memberships in three tiers — Regent (12 seats), Sovereign (30), Founding Circle (15). Each is a full-value 12-month unlimited, crowned at the anniversary gala, names engraved on the founding wall, and closed on the night of the anniversary. Tier perks are experience, not cash: private studio hours, a class of your own, first call on every launch through the year.
offers.Why it works: A numbered annual sells belonging, not a price. Three tiers let the room choose its commitment instead of negotiating a discount, the cap makes the deadline real, and the ceremony gives every buyer a moment worth telling someone about — which is the referral engine the following month runs on.
offers.What to watch: The cap must stay hard. The moment a seat is re-opened after the close, the number on the wall stops meaning anything and the tier price follows it down.
offers.Model: 99 numbered annuals at an average 25,100; no cash discount beyond the standing pack perks.
offers.Stacked perks: Coronation ceremony with a numbered seat; engraved founding wall; private studio hour per tier; first call on 2028 launches; a birthday class for the member’s own day.

offers.name: The Founding 57
offers.tagline: 57 numbered memberships. Full price. Founders' perks.
offers.Commercial job: Sell annuals at list through scarcity
offers.Mechanics: 57 numbered annual memberships India-wide (KH 30, SHQ 15, KK 12; ~half in April). Full list + Founders' kit: 2 extra privates (4 total), name on the Founders' wall, 48-hour early booking, 4 extra guest passes, retail box. Stacked: Founders' wall, 48-hour early booking, 4 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: With no list-price change, scarcity replaces a price lock. Kwality sold 33 annuals in 12 months, so 57 seats across two waves is a stretch but credible. A public counter creates urgency without a code. Annual renews at 71%.

offers.name: The Long Game
offers.tagline: Go longer, get more time.
offers.Mechanics: Annual +30 days; 6M +14 days; 3M +6 classes. For members with 8+ visits a month and 1M/pack renewers.
offers.Why it works: Approved 2027 playbook offer: 8–14% effective, rewards length.

hook: The anniversary: numbered annuals, capped and closed
job: Sell the year’s flagship — numbered annual memberships, capped by seat count and hard-closed on a date — inside an anniversary programme that fills the room for a month.
moment: The anniversary is the product, and the flagship is a numbered annual: scarce, tiered, and sold as belonging rather than as a price. Around it runs the birthday programme — a coronation gala, themed classes across all formats, a founding-members wall, and daily celebration moments — so the renewal stream is sold by the room, not by a discount.

actions.text: Coronation build: number the 57 seats, brief the team on the three tiers, and open the waitlist to the founding book.
Anniversary identity live: birthday campaign across WhatsApp, email and Instagram, with the seat counter on every asset.
Founding book calls: every member from the launch year is called personally and offered their original number where it is still free.
The Coronation Gala: one evening, all 57 seats on the wall, tier reveals, cake, and the first names engraved.
Birthday class week: every format runs a themed anniversary class — throwback playlists, founding-year choreography, guest instructors.
Founding wall reveal: photographs of every member from the launch year, printed and hung, with a card and a personal invitation to the gala.
Regent tier push: the 12 highest-value seats are worked one to one, with private studio hours as the closer.
Comeback party: one evening class for everyone who lapsed in the launch year, free, no pitch in the room.
Birthday treats all week: cake at the desk, a photographer in the studio, member birthday cards, and the anniversary playlist.
Final seats: publish the remaining count every morning, and close every open conversation before the ceremony.
The Closing Night: last seats crowned, wall completed, and the 2028 waitlist opened to the room before it leaves.
Afterparty handover: every coronation member gets a thirty-day plan, so May starts on a habit instead of a receipt.

hook: Gifting as a revenue stream, not a promotion

hook: Annual commitments, capped and dated
job: Take the year’s biggest commitment window without discounting the year: capped numbered annuals, a closed date, and a renewal ladder on the expiring book.
moment: The annual is the offer. A second wave of numbered memberships opens to the list first and closes on a date, the renewal ladder re-signs whatever comes due, and winback catches anyone who let a membership lapse during the year.

offers.name: The Pre-Solution
offers.tagline: Buy in December, start any day until 15 January.

offers.Model: 84 in pool × 17.9% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 15.0 buyers × ₹24.1k ticket (32% take the featured product) = ₹3.6L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Gift the Habit
offers.tagline: A year-end gift that lasts.

offers.Why it works: Second gifting window after the gifting window.

offers.tagline: A different perk every day for 12 days.
offers.Commercial job: Daily urgency in a slow month
offers.Mechanics: 12–23 Dec: each day a new single-day perk on 12-class pack+ purchases (guest passes, bottle, freeze, consult…), average value ₹1,000, on top of the standing 15%.
offers.Why it works: Daily content and a reason to buy today.

offers.tagline: You took 87 classes with us. Here's to 2028.

offers.Why it works: People share year-in-review pages. It reminds lapsed clients of their own habit.
offers.What to watch: Needs a stats export per client.

offers.name: The Guest List
offers.tagline: Family's in town. Bring them.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed: standing 15% on a 12-class pack + 2 guest passes for holiday visitors. Stacked: 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: Guests become January leads.

offers.name: 2027 Wrapped → 2028 Prescription
offers.tagline: Your year in numbers, and the plan for next year.

offers.Expected revenue: ₹14.0L counted (+₹1.4L vs the ₹12.6L stream plan) · 54 buyers

offers.Mechanics: 6M or Annual renewal at list + 30 days.
offers.Why it works: Locks the best clients before January choices.

offers.name: The 100 Club

offers.Mechanics: Members with 100+ classes in 2027: Members' Circle perks + one trainer session on renewal at list.
offers.Why it works: The top 10% of clients make 54–60% of class revenue; recognition costs little.

hook: Data-led renewal and the January pre-sale
job: Renew on usage: every member’s own year in data, ending in a renewal prescription — then pre-sell January before the calendar resets.
moment: The renewal stream closes the year. A personal year-in-review is the argument, a prescription renewal is the ask, the gifting tail carries into January, and the pre-sale takes next year’s annuals before the discount season can argue against them.

offers.name: 21 in 21 Kickstart
offers.tagline: 21 days unlimited. Hit 15 classes and the fee comes off your 3M.
offers.Commercial job: Low-risk entry that filters for habit, then upgrades
offers.Mechanics: 21-day unlimited intro (Mumbai ₹10,500, Bengaluru ₹8,399 — Kenkere already sells "The 21-Day Trial"). Attend 15+ classes → the full fee is credited against a 3M bought within 7 days of the end (≈18–20% on the 3M).
offers.Expected revenue: ₹3.8L counted (+₹32.4k vs the ₹3.5L stream plan) · 28 buyers
offers.Why it works: Kenkere's problem is conversion: 3.4% lead→commitment, website leads reach a trial 7.5% of the time. A cheap, time-boxed entry gets more people to commit to something, and the 15-class gate selects the clients who will renew. Revenue shown is the kickstart fee only; the 3M follow-on is upside.
offers.What to watch: Kickstart → 3M conversion (target 35%). Cap the 3M credit so effective discount on the 3M stays ≤20%.
offers.Model: 81 in pool × 25.2% plan rate × 1.35 conversion factor = 27.5 buyers × ₹13.8k ticket (75% take the featured product) = ₹3.8L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: The Habit Refund
offers.tagline: Show up 36 times in 90 days and we pay you back.
offers.Commercial job: Raise first-purchase value and build the early habit
offers.Mechanics: Pay 3M at list within 72 hours of the trial (instead of the standing 15% now). Attend 36 classes in the first 90 days → 20% of the price back as studio credit, valid 60 days for the next purchase.
offers.Why it works: Clients choose between 15% now or 20% later if they show up. Committed buyers pick the refund, and the credit can only be spent on a second purchase, which is where loyalty forms (first purchases renew at 40–45%, repeat renewals at 64–68%). Usage is the strongest renewal predictor in the data (fully used 62% vs under-half 22%).
offers.What to watch: Earn rate (plan for ~40% earning, so the real cost is ~8%). Credit redemption within 60 days.

offers.name: Habit Insurance
offers.tagline: Commit for 3 months. Life happens; your membership waits.
offers.Commercial job: Remove the "what if I travel or get sick" objection to 3M
offers.Mechanics: 3M at the standing 15% + stacked: 2 extra freeze attempts, a 15-minute goal-setting consult with a trainer, 2 guest passes for friends. Stacked: 2 extra freezes, 15-min trainer consult, 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: Same cash cost as the standing perk, but the stack makes the 3M feel safe. 3M renews at 68–74% vs 53–59% for 1M, so moving first buyers up the ladder is worth more than the discount.
offers.What to watch: Share of January new buyers on 3M+ (target ≥45%).

offers.name: Unfinished Business
offers.tagline: You left 2 classes behind. We kept them.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed clients who let credits expire get up to 2 of them reinstated when they buy a 12-class pack or bigger. Replaces the standing 15% (not stacked).
offers.Expected revenue: ₹1.5L counted (+₹34.3k vs the ₹1.1L stream plan) · 22 buyers
offers.Why it works: Endowment effect: people value "their" lost classes more than an equal discount. It also reaches the under-used clients (packs used under 50% renew at 22–24%) with a reason to return.
offers.What to watch: Only clients with expired unused credits. Bengaluru effective ≈21.6%.
offers.Model: 254 in pool × 8.0% plan rate × 1.10 conversion factor = 22.4 buyers × ₹6.5k ticket (27% take the featured product) = ₹1.5L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: An Old Friend
offers.tagline: A comeback class, a plan, and the 15% you already have.
offers.Commercial job: Baseline lapsed sequence with a human touch
offers.Mechanics: Standing 15% on an 8-class pack or bigger + free comeback class + 15-minute "reset" consult with a trainer and a 2-week attendance plan. Clients with ≥₹50k lifetime spend get a manager call. Stacked: comeback class, 15-min reset consult, 2-week attendance plan.
offers.Why it works: Keeps the cash cost at the standing perk and adds structure. Reactivations earn ₹4.8–8.3k each, so personal calls go only to the high-value group.
offers.What to watch: Reactivation rate of the 61–365-day pool (Bandra 2.8% → 3.4% a month).

offers.name: The Second Chance
offers.tagline: 36 days for the price of 30.
offers.Commercial job: Catch December lapsers before the habit is gone
offers.Mechanics: Clients lapsed 0–90 days after Nov–Dec: 1M at list + 6 extra days. Valid 2–20 Jan.
offers.Why it works: Recent lapsers return fastest; time is cheaper than cash at 42–45% fill. Effective 20%, the cap for ≤1M products.
offers.What to watch: Restrict to 0–90 days lapsed so it doesn't pull forward active renewals.

offers.name: The Re-Up Ladder
offers.tagline: The longer you commit, the bigger the thank-you.
offers.Commercial job: Renew at list and push the ticket up
offers.Mechanics: Renew at list: 1M +1 class, 3M +7 days, 6M +14 days, Annual +30 days and a Members' Circle invite. No % off.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹7.2L counted (+₹66.7k vs the ₹6.6L stream plan) · 42 buyers
offers.Why it works: Full-price renewers renew again at 61–68% vs 50–54% after discounts. The ladder rewards upgrades (20–26% of renewals already upgrade) without training clients to wait for codes.
offers.What to watch: Renewal ticket vs plan (KH ₹24.0k, SHQ ₹21.7k, KK ₹14.3k).
offers.Model: 42 in pool × 97.4% plan rate × 1.02 conversion factor = 41.5 buyers × ₹17.4k ticket = ₹7.2L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Usage Prescription
offers.tagline: We looked at your last 3 months. Here's the plan that fits.
offers.Commercial job: Rebuild the renewal ticket with data
offers.Mechanics: T-14 call with a usage-based recommendation: 8+ visits a month on 1M → 3M at list + 7 days; under 50% used → a smaller pack + attendance plan. 2 guest passes for renewing on the prescribed product within 7 days. Stacked: 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: Bandra's ticket fell ₹24.3k → ₹21.2k from mix drift, not refusals. Usage-based advice moves 8+-visit members up and keeps light users from lapsing.

offers.name: Go Long in January
offers.tagline: 6 months or a year, plus a month on us.
offers.Mechanics: 6M or Annual renewal at list + 30 extra days. Annual renewers also get the standing annual perks.
offers.Why it works: Jan-2026 sold 8 annuals (₹12.5L) that come due now. Long commitments retain best (6M 63–77%, annual 71%).
offers.What to watch: Effective 16.7% on 6M, 8.2% on Annual — within the 3M+ cap only for annual; keep 6M to +21 days if strict.

hook: Renewal book + full-price trial conversion
job: Re-up the expiring annual book at full value, convert trial demand at full price, and reactivate the lapsed — without setting a discount anchor for the year.
moment: The month is built from three revenue streams. Renewals carry it: an annual book comes due and is re-signed in a ladder of longer terms. New clients convert from trial at list, with a refund-of-habit mechanism instead of a price cut. Winback works the lapsed list with a single, honest comeback offer.

offers.name: Love Language Menu
offers.tagline: Pick the perk that says it best.
offers.Mechanics: New 3M+ buyers: standing 15% + choose one: Quality Time (30-min private), Gifts (retail item), Acts of Service (2 extra freezes + priority booking), Words (written 12-week plan from a trainer).
offers.Expected revenue: ₹2.2L counted (+₹24.8k vs the ₹2.0L stream plan) · 13 buyers
offers.Why it works: Choice increases perceived value at no extra cost; every option is worth less than a 30-minute private. Only 3M+ qualifies, which pulls the first ticket toward ₹42–49k.
offers.What to watch: Track which perk is chosen; it tells you what new clients value.
offers.Model: 56 in pool × 24.8% plan rate × 0.95 conversion factor = 13.2 buyers × ₹16.7k ticket (24% take the featured product) = ₹2.2L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: The Duo Rate
offers.tagline: Trial together, start together, train together.
offers.Commercial job: Two genuinely new clients per sale
offers.Mechanics: Two first-timers who trial together and both buy a 12-class pack+ within 72 hours: standing 15% each + one shared 30-minute duo private. Stacked: duo private shared.
offers.Why it works: Replaces BOGO, which went mostly to existing clients (6–21% new) and renewed at 33–53%. Only two new clients unlock it, and referrals convert at 25% at Kwality.
offers.What to watch: Both buyers must be new. Effective ≈21.7% Mumbai, 22.9% Bengaluru.

offers.name: Plus-One, Minus Excuses
offers.tagline: Bring a friend. When they join, you both win.
offers.Mechanics: Friend: newcomer intro + standing 15%. Referrer: 2 bonus classes when the friend buys a commitment product.
offers.Why it works: Referral is the cheapest channel with 25% conversion at Kwality. The referrer bonus is acquisition cost, not a discount to the buyer.

offers.name: Come Back as a Pair
offers.tagline: Return with a friend. Their first class is on us.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed client returns at standing 15% on a 12-class pack; brings a friend for a free intro. If the friend buys, the lapsed client gets 2 guest passes and 48-hour priority booking.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹1.1L counted (+₹24.7k vs the ₹0.8L stream plan) · 20 buyers
offers.Why it works: Two streams from one message: reactivation and a warm new lead. Rewards are seats and access, so the cash cost stays at 15%.
offers.What to watch: Friends who buy (counts as new-client revenue).
offers.Model: 234 in pool × 7.8% plan rate × 1.10 conversion factor = 20.0 buyers × ₹5.3k ticket (25% take the featured product) = ₹1.1L modelled; 100% of uplift counted
offers.Stacked perks: friend intro · 2 guest passes · priority booking

offers.name: We Need to Talk
offers.tagline: It's not you. It was our schedule. Let's try again.
offers.Mechanics: Break-up letter themed message. Standing 15% on 1M + comeback class + 2 extra freezes so they can't "break up" again over travel. Stacked: comeback class, 2 extra freezes.
offers.Why it works: the pair gives a story without a deeper discount. Freezes answer the most common lapse reason without cash.

offers.name: The Reunion Class
offers.tagline: One Saturday, all your old class friends.
offers.Commercial job: Turn a hosted class into reactivations
offers.Mechanics: Hosted reunion class Sat 13 Feb for lapsed clients. Encore QR at the door: 12-class pack at 12% + 1 bonus class within 7 days.
offers.Why it works: Hosted visits convert at 1–3% without a door offer; the Encore mechanic with a named associate is what lifts them.
offers.What to watch: Conversion at the door (target 10% of attendees).

offers.name: The Couple's Plan
offers.tagline: Renew with your workout partner.
offers.Mechanics: Two members renewing 3M+ together: 5% off each + one shared 30-minute duo private.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹8.1L counted (+₹1.4L vs the ₹6.7L stream plan) · 51 buyers
offers.Why it works: Pairs keep each other attending, and attendance predicts renewal. A hypothesis to test: tag pair renewals and compare their next renewal rate.
offers.What to watch: Next-renewal rate of pairs vs singles (data gap until tagged).
offers.Model: 44 in pool × 114.5% plan rate × 1.02 conversion factor = 51.4 buyers × ₹15.7k ticket (18% take the featured product) = ₹8.1L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Better Together Renewals
offers.tagline: Renew and bring someone in.
offers.Mechanics: Renew at list; if a friend you refer buys in February, +7 days (unlimited) or +1 class (packs).
offers.Why it works: Renewal moments are when clients are happiest; ask for the referral then.

offers.name: Usage Prescription
offers.tagline: Your renewal, sized to how you actually train.
offers.Mechanics: T-14 usage-based recommendation: 8+ visits on 1M → 3M at list + 7 days; under 50% used → smaller pack + plan.
offers.Why it works: Same evidence as January: mix drift lowered the ticket; usage advice reverses it.

hook: Referral-led new client growth
job: Grow new clients through the second seat rather than a discount: the companion membership is the offer, and the first membership is never cut.
moment: New clients are the growth stream this month, and they arrive in pairs. A duo rate prices the second seat, a referral credit pays out in classes rather than cash, and winback returns to the members who left as a pair — so acquisition is bought with product, not with margin.

offers.name: Strong Women Squad
offers.tagline: 4 weeks, one squad, same time every week.
offers.Mechanics: 12-class pack at standing 15% + fixed squad slot, trainer WhatsApp group, week-4 progress check, graduation class.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹2.1L counted (+₹11k vs the ₹2.0L stream plan) · 15 buyers
offers.Why it works: Renewers average 6.4 visits in the first half of a membership vs 2.6–3.4 for lapsers. A squad makes those early visits happen.
offers.Model: 51 in pool × 25.3% plan rate × 1.15 conversion factor = 14.8 buyers × ₹14.1k ticket (60% take the featured product) = ₹2.1L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: She Moves: Pay It Forward
offers.tagline: Start your 3 months. Gift a woman her first class.
offers.Commercial job: Purpose-led acquisition with a built-in referral
offers.Mechanics: homecoming week week: new 3M+ buyers get the standing 15% + 2 guest passes, and we gift a free class to a woman they nominate (mother, colleague, friend). Gifted classes enter the Encore flow. Stacked: gift class for a nominee, 2 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: Gives the purchase a story to share. The gifted class is acquisition cost and creates a warm lead.

offers.name: The Pre-Game
offers.tagline: Don't wait for April. Get in early.
offers.Commercial job: Stop March trials waiting for the anniversary
offers.Mechanics: March trials: buy within 72 hours at standing 15% → early access to April's anniversary box + 1 bonus class on 3M. Stacked: early access to April box.
offers.Why it works: March is a trough (Kwality ₹19–20L). Giving March buyers April status removes the reason to delay.

offers.name: Re-Run Your Best Month
offers.tagline: Remember March 2025? 18 classes. Let's beat it.
offers.Mechanics: Message shows the client's best month. 1M at list; match that class count → +6 days.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹1.3L counted (+₹28.3k vs the ₹1.0L stream plan) · 21 buyers
offers.Why it works: Personal data beats generic offers and sets a goal. The reward is earned, so cost only lands on clients who attend.
offers.What to watch: Needs a per-client best-month field from Momence.
offers.Model: 262 in pool × 7.8% plan rate × 1.05 conversion factor = 21.4 buyers × ₹6k ticket (23% take the featured product) = ₹1.3L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Class of 2024 Reunion
offers.tagline: Where it all started. One class, the whole launch crew.
offers.Mechanics: Hosted reunion for clients lapsed 1–2 years (and 61–365). Rebuy within 7 days: 12-class pack at 12% + 1 bonus class.
offers.Why it works: May–Sep 2024 brought 1,000+ first visits at Bandra; 638 are now lapsed 1–2 years. Reaching people who already know the studio is the cheapest reach Bandra has.
offers.What to watch: Reunion RSVPs → attendance → purchase. Repeat in September.

offers.name: The Homecoming
offers.tagline: Come back, and bring her with you.
offers.Mechanics: Lapsed clients returning 8–14 Mar: standing 15% on an 8-class pack + a free class to gift a friend. Stacked: gift class for a friend.
offers.Why it works: Simple, on-theme, cash cost unchanged.

offers.name: Pre-Game Upgrade
offers.tagline: Moving up? Your anniversary box ships early.
offers.Mechanics: 1M renewers with 8+ visits a month → 3M at list + anniversary retail item + 2 guest passes.
offers.Expected revenue: ₹5.8L counted (+₹96.5k vs the ₹4.8L stream plan) · 33 buyers
offers.Why it works: 3M renews at 71% at Kenkere vs 59% for 1M. A retail item costs far less than a % code.
offers.Model: 48 in pool × 68.9% plan rate × 1.00 conversion factor = 33.2 buyers × ₹17.4k ticket (21% take the featured product) = ₹5.8L modelled; 100% of uplift counted

offers.name: Lock In Early
offers.tagline: Renew in March, keep April's perks.
offers.Commercial job: Protect Q1 renewals without pull-forward discounts
offers.Mechanics: Members expiring 1 Mar–15 Apr renew at list + 2 bonus classes (packs) or +7 days (unlimited) + first pick of anniversary hosted classes.
offers.Why it works: In 2026 ₹36.7L of Kwality's April came from early renewals at 30%+. Giving March renewers bonus time protects the ticket.

offers.name: Spring Reset Check-in
offers.tagline: Renew with a plan, not a discount.
offers.Mechanics: Every March renewal comes with a 15-minute trainer assessment and a programme. Renew now, start up to 14 days later. Stacked: trainer assessment, flexible start date.
offers.Why it works: Zero-discount baseline for studios that don't need a renewal push in March.

hook: Winback of the launch-year book
job: Rebuild the reactivation stream: bring the lapsed launch cohort home on a reunion offer, and close March trials inside the month instead of letting them slide into April.
moment: Reactivation is the month’s growth stream. A reunion-led winback works the oldest cohort on the book, a trial offer closes in-week so demand does not defer, and a renewal ladder protects the first-quarter book while acquisition runs warm rather than loud.

offers.name: Build Your Box
offers.tagline: The bigger your commitment, the bigger the anniversary box.
offers.Commercial job: Higher-value first purchases at a protected price

offers.name: The Founding 57 · Coronation
offers.tagline: Fifty-seven numbered annual memberships, crowned in a gala: tiers, a founding wall, and a seat that is never sold again.
offers.Commercial job: Sell the flagship of the year: numbered annuals, capped by seat count, closed on the anniversary.
offers.Mechanics: Fifty-seven numbered annual memberships in three tiers — Regent (12 seats), Sovereign (30), Founding Circle (15). Each is a full-value 12-month unlimited, crowned at the anniversary gala, names engraved on the founding wall, and closed on the night of the anniversary. Tier perks are experience, not cash: private studio hours, a class of your own, first call on every launch through the year.
offers.Why it works: A numbered annual sells belonging, not a price. Three tiers let the room choose its commitment instead of negotiating a discount, the cap makes the deadline real, and the ceremony gives every buyer a moment worth telling someone about — which is the referral engine the following month runs on.
offers.What to watch: The cap must stay hard. The moment a seat is re-opened after the close, the number on the wall stops meaning anything and the tier price follows it down.
offers.Model: 59 numbered annuals at an average 15,700; no cash discount beyond the standing pack perks.
offers.Stacked perks: Coronation ceremony with a numbered seat; engraved founding wall; private studio hour per tier; first call on 2028 launches; a birthday class for the member’s own day.

offers.name: The Founding 57

offers.Commercial job: Sell annuals at list through scarcity
offers.Mechanics: 57 numbered annual memberships India-wide (KH 30, SHQ 15, KK 12; ~half in April). Full list + Founders' kit: 2 extra privates (4 total), name on the Founders' wall, 48-hour early booking, 4 extra guest passes, retail box. Stacked: Founders' wall, 48-hour early booking, 4 guest passes.
offers.Why it works: With no list-price change, scarcity replaces a price lock. Kwality sold 33 annuals in 12 months, so 57 seats across two waves is a stretch but credible. A public counter creates urgency without a code. Annual renews at 71%.

offers.name: The Long Game
offers.tagline: Go longer, get more time.
offers.Mechanics: Annual +30 days; 6M +14 days; 3M +6 classes. For members with 8+ visits a month and 1M/pack renewers.
offers.Why it works: Approved 2027 playbook offer: 8–14% effective, rewards length.

hook: The anniversary: numbered annuals, capped and closed
job: Sell the year’s flagship — numbered annual memberships, capped by seat count and hard-closed on a date — inside an anniversary programme that fills the room for a month.
moment: The anniversary is the product, and the flagship is a numbered annual: scarce, tiered, and sold as belonging rather than as a price. Around it runs the birthday programme — a coronation gala, themed classes across all formats, a founding-members wall, and daily celebration moments — so the renewal stream is sold by the room, not by a discount.

actions.text: Coronation build: number the 57 seats, brief the team on the three tiers, and open the waitlist to the founding book.
Anniversary identity live: birthday campaign across WhatsApp, email and Instagram, with the seat counter on every asset.
Founding book calls: every member from the launch year is called personally and offered their original number where it is still free.
The Coronation Gala: one evening, all 57 seats on the wall, tier reveals, cake, and the first names engraved.
Birthday class week: every format runs a themed anniversary class — throwback playlists, founding-year choreography, guest instructors.
Founding wall reveal: photographs of every member from the launch year, printed and hung, with a card and a personal invitation to the gala.
Regent tier push: the 12 highest-value seats are worked one to one, with private studio hours as the closer.
Comeback party: one evening class for everyone who lapsed in the launch year, free, no pitch in the room.
Birthday treats all week: cake at the desk, a photographer in the studio, member birthday cards, and the anniversary playlist.
Final seats: publish the remaining count every morning, and close every open conversation before the ceremony.
The Closing Night: last seats crowned, wall completed, and the 2028 waitlist opened to the room before it leaves.
Afterparty handover: every coronation member gets a thirty-day plan, so May starts on a habit instead of a receipt.
